description_html:
An immaculate studio apartment in a quiet eighth-floor position within the Barbican Arts Centre, overlooking the Sculpture Court.
Full-height, full-width glazed doors and windows provide plenty of natural light and lead onto the balcony/fire escape. The apartment benefits from a pull-down bed with a cleverly designed integrated sofa, together with a built-in wardrobe and drawers.
There is a generous shower room and a useful built-in cupboard housing a washer/dryer. Beautiful wood flooring runs throughout the living area and hallway.
Three lifts serve Frobisher Crescent, and residents have access to the Barbican’s attractive private gardens. The estate’s 24-hour car park attendants can receive parcels and provide key-holding facilities. Parking may be available by separate arrangement with the City of London.
Designed by renowned architects Chamberlin, Powell and Bon, the Grade II listed Barbican Estate is home to the Barbican Arts Centre, including its cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, theatres, restaurants, bars and cafés. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are all nearby.
Please note that, under the terms of the head lease, pets are not permitted.
No onward chain
Service charge: Estimated at £2,221 for the period 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.
Leasehold: 150 years from 2010.
Ground rent: £150 per annum.
